name.zh: 徒手单腿罗马尼亚硬拉

purpose.zh: 练大腿后侧和臀部，单腿站得更稳
purpose.en: Strengthen the back of your thigh and your glutes, and stand steadier on one leg.

text.zh: 支撑腿微弯，上身向前倾，后腿往后抬
text.en: Soften the standing knee, tip forward and let the back leg rise

text.zh: 后腿和上身成一条直线，骨盆别歪。
text.en: Keep the back leg in line with your body and your hips level.

text.zh: 手臂自然下垂，背保持平直。
text.en: Let your arms hang straight down and keep your back flat.

commonErrors.zh: 抬起的腿那一侧骨盆往外翻
commonErrors.en: Letting the hip of the lifted leg twist open.

cautions.zh: 腰发紧或疼时前倾少一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back feels tight or hurts, tip less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 英文名缩写 RDL 改全称
主口令去掉「以髋为轴向前折 / hinge」，改「上身向前倾，后腿往后抬」
purpose 去掉「腘绳肌拉长下的控制」改口语
caution「腰椎中立」改「X 时 Y」短句
flags: 派生顶点 ≥0.8 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 注释里真正的停顿只有约 0.6 s，若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
